name: Malzeno
description: (Tag:flying)(Tag:massive-size)(Tag:parasitic)(Tag:poison)The Malzeno is an Elder Dragon known as the Scarlet Feast, wielding Dragon Energy for breaths and attacks. It hosts symbiotic Qurio parasites as a nest in its body. They drain vitality and blood while poisoning targets, returning it to heal, strengthen, and trigger Malzeno's stronger Bloodening form.
